## Consumer sentiment index

The Consumer Sentiment Index fell to 51.7 in the August 2026 survey, down from 55.2 in July and below last August's 58.2. The Current Index fell to 51.9, down from 54.8 in July and below last August's 61.7. The Expectations Index fell to 51.5, down from 55.4 in July and below last August's 55.9.
